Adding LINK.e + XAUt0 means: (a) 4 new addresses declared ONCE in protocolTargets.ts FINANCIAL_TARGETS (linkTokenAddress, xautTokenAddress, priceFeeds.linkUsd, priceFeeds.xauUsd) — the LINK.e token address is 0x5947BB275c521040051D82396192181b413227A3 (already pinned in two guard scripts as fixtures), the XAUt0 address is NOT in the repo (recover from the gold swap at block 91,571,070 and chain-verify symbol/decimals), and the two feed addresses exist only short-form (0x49cc…de9a / 0x1F41…515B) so full values must be resolved + re-verified on-chain before pinning; (b) two new balance blocks in realityService (copy the §4b BTC.b pattern at lines 1443-1469) emitting financial.vault.linkBalance / financial.vault.xautBalance; (c) two new feed entries in the §4e loop (lines 1646-1672) emitting financial.price.linkUsd / financial.price.xauUsd, with the freshness check (readPrice, lines 1624-1645; STALENESS_MAX_S=86_400 at line 1618) refactored to a PER-FEED max-age so XAU gets a market-hours window while crypto keeps 24h — the check is entirely in this one closure, minimal change is adding a maxAgeS field to each feed-loop entry and threading it into readPrice; (d) client: uncomment/extend the drafted LINK entry (trackedAssets.ts lines 127-138) + add a GOLD entry (tone "gold" — TONE_BG already has it), flip the band grid lg:grid-cols-4→3 (line 185), state the market-hours window on the gold card (reuse the `held` slot to avoid new sub-12px sites), add the two /contracts rows + update its headline copy and header comment, update featureStatus.vaultHoldings' what-is-valued comment and the /contracts SEO description in the same commit; (e) guards RED-first: protocol-reality-check.guard financial count 35→39 with exact-id-set update, PRICE_FEED_FIX +2, balanceOf count 15→17, plus three new freshness tests (XAU past-24h-but-in-window SERVES, XAU past-window fails, crypto at 25h STILL fails), and protocol-targets-reconcile literal pins for all 4 new addresses. Verify links reuse the existing "vaultWallet" id — zero codegen.

If the card STATES a market-hours window but the server keeps 24h for XAU/USD, every Sunday the price fails closed and the whole home total reads unavailable — the card would state a policy the system doesn't implement. The client statement and the server's per-feed window must land together.

Measure decimals() on the actual XAUt0 contract before writing the entry (NO FIGURE HE HAS NOT SEEN MEASURED; the wireframe's 0.003144 oz implies but does not prove 6).
